Thank you for sharing. I'll post a shot of the watch I am wearing today in a bit.

It took me a while to come around, but since picking up my first, the 48, I haven't really taken them off my wrist. I've upped the size from the smaller 48 to the standard 44mm, but the masculine styling has remained. It's a beefy watch that handles whatever is thrown it's way; definitely worth a look.

Omega DeVille Prestige Calibre 2500

That is what I am wearing today. It is on a genuine Louisiana alligator strap. The strap it comes with is a black gator, which I have but I swap the straps pretty regularly depending on mood. Right now this is my go to brown strap watch, while I am wearing the Grand Seiko from my other post when I need to match to black shoes.

It is an Omega DeVille from the Prestige collection. I bought it in Bangalore, India about 30% cheaper than I could have gotten it in the US. It has the calibre 2500 movement with coaxial escapement, and is a COSC certified chronometer meaning maintains a daily average rate of between -4/+6 seconds.

Alas, the 8500 is the better movement overall as it was built around the coaxial escapement, but the 2500 is a great workhorse that has proven itself quite durable.
